scope: Read-only text provenance and normalized comparison; no application/rule/database changes. Main catalogue and additional profiles inventoried. Supplemental JSON text inventoried separately. UI/generated labels and source books outside the supplied references are not exhaustively compared.

method.comparison: PDF extracted in column order using PDFium. Case/accents/punctuation normalized; at least 12 consecutive matching words. This is a documentary similarity signal, not a plagiarism finding or a permission verdict. A source used to check a mechanic does not establish the origin of unchanged legacy prose. A paraphrase alone does not establish lawful reuse.
